class.slave.family.WAF: into a family of jon, household slaves
class.peasant.family.WAF: into a family of millet farmers
class.craftsman.family.WAF: into a nyamakala family of artisans
class.landowner.family.WAF: into a free lineage whose men head the villages
class.noble.family.WAF: into a family close to the ruler's court
prof.farmer.desc.WAF: Millet, sorghum, rice in the flooded fields, and the endless wait for rain.
prof.laborer.desc.WAF: Carrying bricks, loading boats, treading mud: any work for pay.
prof.artisan.desc.WAF: Leatherworker, potter or woodcarver: the craft passes from parent to child.
prof.weaver.desc.WAF: You spin cotton and dye cloth with indigo.
prof.midwife.desc.WAF: You deliver babies and know the herbs and the words to say.
prof.merchant.desc.WAF: Salt, gold, kola nuts, cloth: trade routes from the desert to the forests.
prof.sailor.desc.WAF: A Bozo or Sorko fisherman: dugout canoes, nets, cargo up and down the river.
prof.soldier.desc.WAF: Bow, spear and a quiver of poisoned arrows. The lucky ones get a horse.
prof.scribe.desc.WAF: You write letters, contracts and lists in Arabic script for merchants and the court.
prof.physician.desc.WAF: You heal by Arabic books and by the experience of local healers.
prof.priest.desc.WAF: You lead prayer in the mosque, preach on Fridays and teach the law.
prof.landholder.desc.WAF: The village, the fields, the people and slaves of the lineage, and answering for them all to the ruler.
prof.magistrate.desc.WAF: Service at court: tribute, judgments, errands for the ruler.
prof.matron.as.WAF: the mistress of a great household
prof.matron.desc.WAF: Co-wives, children, slaves, the granaries: it all rests on you.
prof.household_slave.desc.WAF: Pounding millet, carrying water, serving in the master's house.
prof.field_slave.desc.WAF: Work in the master's fields, living in a separate slave village.
prof.officer.desc.WAF: You lead mail-clad horsemen on war horses brought across the desert.
prof.workshop_owner.as.WAF: the head of the family workshop
prof.workshop_owner.desc.WAF: Your own apprentices, commissions from the nobles and the respect of the whole quarter.
prof.shipowner.as.WAF: the head of a trading house
prof.shipowner.desc.WAF: Your own camel caravans and boats on the Niger, agents in several towns.
prof.official.desc.WAF: Counting tribute, writing letters in the ruler's name, power over other people's affairs.
prof.overseer.desc.WAF: The master has trusted you with the fields and the other slaves.
prof.griot.desc: A jeli: singer, keeper of genealogies and memory. No wedding or council happens without you.
prof.blacksmith.desc: A numu: you smelt ore and forge hoes and spears. People respect you and fear you a little: a smith knows hidden powers.
prof.hunter.desc: The hunters' brotherhood, amulets, the bush and its beasts. Hunters know herbs and hidden paths.
prof.salt_trader.desc: Slabs of salt from Taghaza across the desert by camel. Riches, or death by thirst.
prof.gold_miner.desc: The mines of Bure: in the dry season you dig shafts and wash the earth in calabashes.
prof.marabout.desc: A teacher of the Quran and of the law. You write amulets with verses, and people call on you to bless and to judge.
prof.healer.desc: Herbs, divining with cowries and talking with spirits. People come to you when nothing else has helped.
focus.learn.desc.WAF: Quranic school: verses on a wooden board and Arabic letters. The teacher must be paid
focus.study.desc.WAF: The scholars of Timbuktu and Djenne, books, law, grammar. It costs money
focus.health.desc.WAF: Rest, herbs, good food and sleep in the shade
focus.rest.desc.WAF: Festivals, griots' songs, talk around the fire
focus.religion.desc.WAF: Prayers, offerings to the ancestors, the blessings of marabouts
focus.service.desc.WAF: Bow, spear, horse and campaigns with the ruler's army
lifestyle.food.plain.desc.WAF: Millet porridge, baobab-leaf sauce, fish from the river
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.WAF: Rice, meat, milk, honey, dates from across the desert. Good for your health
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.WAF: Roast rams, guests, the songs of griots. Costly
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.WAF: Riding, hunting, spear practice. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.medicine.home.desc.WAF: Herbs, bark and the advice of old women
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.WAF: Amulets with verses, offerings to spirits, divining with cowries
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.WAF: A household physician trained in Arabic books. Costly, but fewer deaths
lifestyle.baths.rarely.desc.WAF: The river, when there is time
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.WAF: Daily washing, clean clothes, incense. You must live in town
religion.african_traditional.niani: the faith of the ancestors and the spirits of the land
